from pathlib import Path

input_path = Path("/mnt/data/spreadsheet/168-17/1_168-17_input.xlsx")

wb = load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb["Statement"]

# Locate the first instance of "Invoice No." in column A
invoice_row = None
for row in range(1, ws.max_row + 1):
    val = ws.cell(row=row, column=1).value
    if isinstance(val, str) and val.strip() == "Invoice No.":
        invoice_row = row
        break

if invoice_row is None:
    raise ValueError("Could not find 'Invoice No.' in column A of the Statement sheet.")

# Delete all rows preceding the first "Invoice No." row so it moves to A1
if invoice_row > 1:
    ws.delete_rows(1, invoice_row - 1)

output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)

# Verification: reopen and print relevant cells
verify_wb = load_workbook(output_path, data_only=False)
verify_ws = verify_wb["Statement"]

print("A1 after deletion:", verify_ws["A1"].value)
print("Cells in Statement!A2:E12 after saving:")
for r in range(2, 13):
    print([verify_ws.cell(row=r, column=c).value for c in range(1, 6)])
